notes.37021.8: The first two lines are the end of a different tablet (37021) from the rest (65173). The spelling is phonetic throughout. APĒSĒ and MISOUS are written in capitals by the edition as unexplained letter sequences; Phl[...]oph[ō]na is unexplained. *phakarinea* is an unidentified object, presumably the thing stolen. The powers invoked are Bia, Moira and Ananke. “Have punished and cut down” renders ἐκ⟨δ⟩είκησαν καὶ ἐξεθέρεισον, apparently for ἐξεδίκησαν and ἐξεθέρισαν; the second could also be an imperative. The last line is magical names and is left untranslated. Lines 8–9: ἐξεθέρεισον is an imperative to the lord invoked, 'cut down', and ἐκ⟨δ⟩είκησαν is read as one too, 'avenge'; εἰ μή ('if not') fits the imperatives poorly and is kept as it stands.

nodes.text: Below, Force, Fate, Necessity: I write down
the one who took my *phakarinea* from me; I cast a shadow over [him]
from hair, from head, from the [...] forehead,
nostrils, teeth of the mou[th], neck, breasts,
belly, si[des], se[me]n, buttocks, backs of the thighs, knees, shins, feet,
fingers and toes, all twenty that he has, if not —
avenge [me] and cut down the [man] of Caecilius,
